newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Doosan Bev, Doosan Glass trading halted.
newsitem.headline: Doosan Bev, Doosan Glass trading halted.

text.p: The Korea Stock Exchange said on Thursday it would halt trading of Doosan Beverage Co and Doosan Glass Co for one day to punish them for "insincerely notifying" their plan to acquire shares in a third company.
An exchange statement said the two companies had recently cancelled a plan announced in January to jointly purchase a 99.998 percent stake in a small company in Taejon.
Details on the third company were not available.
Trading will resume from the morning session on Friday, the statement said.
Doosan Beverage last traded at 31,200 won per share and Doosan Glass at 9,400 won.
